objectives.label: Bring the tax caravan safe to {target}
Beat off the thieves who wait for it

title: The tax caravan
His lordship's silver
summary: The tax of {settlement} goes to {target} under guard, and the lord wants it guarded by someone he trusts.
offer: The tax goes to {target} this week, and every cutthroat in the county knows it. His lordship will trust it to nobody else. {distance}, {direction}.
complete: Every coin accounted for. His lordship names you a friend of his house.
